issues.description: The getter for the StockIngredient name is inconsistently named across artifacts: the template repository defines and uses getIngredientName(), while the solution repository defines and uses getName(). The problem statement asks students to “add getters for all the private fields” but does not prescribe exact getter names. This mismatch can confuse students about which getter name to implement and which name the rest of the code expects (Stock.findStockIngredient() implementations in template and solution call different getters).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the getter name for the StockIngredient name across all artifacts and update callers accordingly. For example, rename getIngredientName() to getName() in the template (and update Stock.findStockIngredient usage to call getName()), or alternatively change the solution to use getIngredientName(). Also update the problem statement to explicitly state the expected getter names (e.g., getName(), getPrice(), getQuantity()).
